name: Add guides to the canvas or frames
snippet: Enable rulers. Before you can add guides to your file, you must enable rulers on the canvas. Open the Main menu. Hover over View and select Rulers.

name: Create layout guides
snippet: From the Layout guide section of the right sidebar, find the layout guide you want to toggle, and click / to show/hide it. Create and apply layout guide styles.
